description: Pay $0.02 USDC to store a file for 7 days. Send filename, optional content_type, and base64-encoded file bytes as JSON. Max file size: 10 MB. Returns a token and a stable GET URL. Network: Base Mainnet. Each request stores one file and returns a retrieval token plus expiry timestamp.
